isolated.reason: An owner frame exists, but compound exports are not assumed rendered without explicit evidence.

composition.reason: A component frame does not prove composition in every supported surface.

journey.reason: Static frames do not prove entry, action, completion, and recovery journeys.

responsive.reason: No complete 320–1920 rendered evidence matrix is recorded for every export.

rtl.reason: No complete rendered RTL matrix is recorded for every export.

a11y.reason: Frame presence alone does not prove semantics, keyboard, focus, or announcements.

async.reason: Default for primitives without async state; override when applicable.

composition.reason: Rendered inside FormField in the owner frame and executed by check:data-entry-frame-runtime.

responsive.reason: Chromium geometry executed at 320,375,390,768,1024,1280,1440,1920 without horizontal overflow.

a11y.reason: Axe executed on the rendered Input frame at all eight viewport widths after accessible-name defects were fixed.
